name: WebChoreArena
description: WebChoreArena is a reproducible benchmark consisting of 532 curated web browsing tasks designed to evaluate agents on tedious and complex web tasks beyond general browsing. It integrates challenges such as massive memory retrieval, precise calculation, and long-term memory across multiple webpages.
reputation: A very recent benchmark with little established community adoption so far, but it is positioned as a reproducible testbed for challenging web-agent tasks.
notes: Built on WebArena simulation environments; focuses on memory, calculation, and long-term memory challenges; shows room for improvement even for advanced LLMs.
